metadata.title: Fiber Optic Cable Catalog, Full Product Range | Vocom
metadata.description: Every fiber optic cable Vocom supplies in one list: loose tube, ribbon, micro, ADSS, drop, data center trunk and connectors. Counts, codes and lead times.

attributes.text: Every cable, duct, vault and connector Vocom supplies, with codes, fiber counts and construction. Outside plant, ribbon, micro, aerial, drop and data center. All of it sourced build-to-order from tier 1 manufacturers, delivered in 6 to 8 weeks, with 2 to 3 week expedited air freight available.
Need a different spec? We also build to custom order.
Gel-filled stranded loose tube for duct, aerial lashed and direct burial routes.

attributes.text: Ribbon and High Fiber Count Cable
Flat and rollable ribbon for mass fusion splicing where duct space is the constraint.

attributes.text: Field-terminable and factory-terminated hardware for outdoor and indoor use.
Build-to-order, specified to your route, count and jacket, not off a fixed shelf.
Fujikura preform glass, tier 1 manufacturing, consistent quality.
Lead times that move, supply when domestic loose-tube is quoted months out.
Import/export handled, documentation, customs and delivery coordinated.
Founded in 1998, a supplier that also runs networks.
Need a Fiber Built to Your Exact Specification?
Fiber count, jacket, rating and connector, we can source and build any fiber optic cable to match your spec.
